state_red.assertion: No durable owner pause existed to fence new calls while preserving in-flight receipts.

cli_red.assertion: The compiled CLI rejected the pause subcommand.

supervisor_red.assertion: A waiting verifier/model supervisor ignored an owner pause set after setup.

authority_red.assertion: A stored pause masked a revoked GitHub grant on work-once.

verified: Owner control is a separate durable record and append-only revision history; pause and audit commit atomically, including queued jobs before execution exists. An injected audit failure rolls back the control update and reports storage failure.

Compare-and-swap revisions prevent stale resume from clearing a newer pause. Repeated new pause requests advance the revision. Clearing pause preserves candidate binding, checkpoint, security holds, provider pin and merge authority.

Paused jobs do not starve other queue entries. Productive/free-merge claims, new model charges, operation intents, publication reservations and merge reservation/dispatch reject owner pause. Replay of existing accounting and operation/merge completion receipts remains allowed.

Workflow-bound audit observers check the current lease and owner pause both before setup and before supervisor release. A real supervised Python command creates no effect after late pause, for both model and verifier admission.

A real-Git WorkflowGuard regression refuses productive transition, model admission, verifier admission and publication validation after pause, preserves checkpoint/evidence, and still records an already-started operation receipt. Pause is not reported as resource exhaustion.

Recovery/pause deferrals preserve candidates instead of entering destructive failure cleanup; background attempt receipts distinguish owner pause from execution failure without masking authorization rejection.

Compiled autopr pause/resume uses repository authorization; resume shares the normal native/provider-role/resource preflight. Unready or unauthorized resume leaves pause unchanged. Background dispatch still performs its own deployed-service equality check.
Read-only status exposes pause intent, and detached wait returns blocked while preserving work. Revoked authorization on work-once retains exit 2 even when pause is set.
Already-dispatched autonomous merges can still reconcile and debit exactly once after a pause. Pause never claims it can undo an in-flight remote mutation.
limits: Pause is a dispatch request, not proof that current processes stopped. Active admitted work may finish; CLI responses explicitly leave live-worker enforcement and quiescence unverified. Older deployed workers do not gain support from writing the new state.
Resume currently clears only explicit pause. Resume --wait, merge-authority upgrades, cancel/teardown, provider switch, and adopt/readopt controls remain unfinished.

Successful ready native resume has not been accepted live; compiled tests prove durable pause and failed readiness/authorization refusal, while store/guard tests prove safe clearing and hold preservation.
Discord pause/resume/selection controls, durable owner follow-up inbox, owned-candidate native conversation handoff, scope revision/re-review, and durable progress/deployment updates remain open.
No production rollout, live Discord/native acceptance, hosted CI acceptance, fault soak or unattended live soak completed in this change. No child issue is closed.
